item.semantic_category: diacritic below /a̭/ and /o̭/ indicates pharyngeal friction

An inverted, reversed /ʔ/ is used in text to indicate a voiced, unemitted sound which precedes the ejected [pʼ]; we use ¿ as a substitute for that symbol. Diacritic over /p̌/ indicates larygeal feature.
